items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Well Joe Phillip liked whiskey and Poe Pointer, he liked to drink and he'd be up all day and he might have parades, I'd use him on parades.

ctx.x: Well they don't sound right, those guys. They sound refined and classy and everything. Yeah. It makes a difference. When did you start playing in brass bands? We didn't get to that.

In brass bands? Oh, let's see. 1940. My first brass band job, when I played with Howard, I was playing with Howard. And then he and Lawrence, Lawrence Morell, and then they decided to form a brass band. Then I would play him with him. And in between time I'd play with Howard. You see? Then I was getting a lot of work myself, you see? And I never carried all the best Alvin Alcorn, Joe Phillip. I carried all the Hellfire fellas with me, you know? Because I had a lot of business in Sidney Diggs. You heard talk of…
appetizer on, started on trucks you know. And what about Mardi Gras? Did you play many of those
